title: I think people are less willing to write graffiti or burn their own house down. When you ask folks to build out their own space rather than sharecrop
summary: I think people are less willing to write graffiti or burn their own house down. When you ask folks to build out their own space rather than sharecrop for silos behaviors may switch. At very least you can ignore the noise #prosocialweb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I think people are less willing to write graffiti or burn their own house down.

When you ask folks to build out their own space rather than sharecrop for silos behaviors may switch.

At very least you can ignore the noise
#prosocialweb
